from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to cause classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or charge explicitly stated in the document (e.g., '执行异议', '诈骗罪', '玩忽职守罪')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal domain indicated by the document (e.g., 'Criminal', 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Execution')")
    procedure_keywords: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Key procedural terms found in the text that distinguish the category (e.g., ['复议', '执行', '赔偿'])")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
